name: Plus381 Tools
description: Plus381 Robotics team parts library: import, publish and auto-sync.
description_full:
Connects KiCad to the Plus381 Robotics shared parts library (github.com/plus381-robotics/kicad-parts).

- Setup: downloads the library, registers all Plus381_* libraries and the PLUS381_PARTS path variable.
- Import part: turns a SnapEDA / Mouser / UltraLibrarian / DigiKey zip into a library part (symbol, footprint, 3D model).
- Publish: shares new and edited parts with the team.
- Shows a red dot on its button when the team has new parts; one click updates the library.

Requires Git (with Git LFS). Publishing asks you to log in to GitHub once from inside KiCad; non-members publish via pull requests. Enable Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API.
